notes: Notes: Strong west winds at ridge-top but calm below. Layer Notes: 80-59cm: Dec 31 V size 6 @ 80 cm; 80-59cm: Problematic layer; 41-39cm: Dec 4 melt/freeze crust. No stability test results on the chart (stability tests column holds only the layer comments). Wind Loading, Specifics, Stability and PF fields blank.
summary: W aspect 28 deg at 2300 m, HS 105 cm: basal FC(DH) 0-11 cm (1F-) and FC 11-33 (1F) under FCxr 33-41 with a 2 cm P-hard Dec 4 melt-freeze crust at 39-41, FCxr 41-59 (1F), a 'problematic' FC 1 mm layer 59-80 cm (4F+) capped by the buried Dec 31 SH (6 mm) at 80 cm, and 25 cm of soft F PP(DF); cold surface (-8.4 C), -9.7 C at 90 cm warming to -1.0 C at the ground; no CT results
reading_issues: Hardness bars, layer boundaries (11, 33, 39, 41, 59, 80 cm) and the temperature dots were measured from pixels. Temperature axis ticks are 37 px per degree C with 0 C at the right frame edge; dot readings accurate to about 0.1 C. The 90 cm dot overlaps its line segments (small centre uncertainty). The 0 cm dot sits on the bottom frame (centre at 0 cm, -1.0 C). No PF is printed (header shows HS and PS only). No stability test annotations on this chart, so tests is empty. Glyphs: square with rounded top read as FCxr; '◎◎' read as MFcr; '+r' read as rimed PP (stored as PP). The red top edge of the 59-80 cm layer is the flagged problematic layer.
